item.name: PHASE 2.5: Create Session (AUTHORIZATION FIX)

request.description:
THE FIX: Create session with authenticated user

Why this works:
✓ You provide JWT token in Authorization header
✓ Backend extracts YOUR userId from token
✓ Session is created with YOUR userId
✓ session.userId === req.userId (authorization check PASSES)
✓ No more 'Unauthorized access to session' error!

REQUIRED FIELDS:
- activity (required): reading, coding, math, sports, art, music, social, gaming, other

OPTIONAL FIELDS:
- sessionType: classroom, homework, exercise, recreation, sleep, other
- sessionName: Custom session name
- description: Session description

Expected 201 Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Session started",
  "session": {
    "_id": "SESSION_ID",
    "userId": "YOUR_USER_ID",
    "activity": "reading",
    "createdAt": "2026-02-19T..."
  }
}

NOTE: SessionId auto-saves in {{sessionId}} variable
